name: Contact Form
summary: Container-responsive context wrapper around one required named native form composed from canonical Input, Textarea, and Button.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Context root rendered as a title-labelled native section when titled and as a generic grouping when untitled.

anatomy.name: grid
anatomy.description: Intrinsic information-and-form layout whose visual and source order remain aligned.

anatomy.name: info
anatomy.description: Optional information region omitted when title, description, and contact details are all absent.

anatomy.name: header
anatomy.description: Optional introduction present only when a title or description is supplied.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional non-empty visible heading whose target-unique id names the native section.

anatomy.name: text
anatomy.description: Optional supporting contact copy that never substitutes for a visible section title.

anatomy.name: detail
anatomy.description: Repeated contact detail using a native actionable link when the value is actionable.

anatomy.name: form
anatomy.description: Required accessible native form composed from canonical Input, Textarea, and Button.

anatomy.name: status
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned truthful form-level response whose live semantics depend on timing and severity.

variants.name: default
variants.description: One optional contact-information region followed by one required native form.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size whose measure, column threshold, and container-relative inset remain private composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Complete contact context; field, action, validation, and response lifecycle states remain dependency- or target-owned.

states.name: detailLinkFocusVisible
states.description: Visible keyboard focus for a native actionable contact detail.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit the complete wrapper when the native form composition is absent or the required localized form label is blank.

behavior.name: conditionalSectionSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty visible title creates and names a native thematic section; an untitled wrapper is a generic div and description alone does not create a section landmark.

behavior.name: nativeFormSemantics
behavior.description: The target renders one native form named by formLabel and owns action, method, submission, pending, confirmed success, failure, retry, anti-abuse, persistence, and response policy.

behavior.name: fieldComposition
behavior.description: Composed Input and Textarea remain the sole native value, name, constraints, validity, message, disabled/read-only, focus, hover, and controlled/uncontrolled owners.

behavior.name: actionComposition
behavior.description: Submit actions compose canonical Button and preserve Button-owned activation, disabled, busy, loading-placement, and focus behavior.

behavior.name: contactDetails
behavior.description: Targets keep contact details in authored order, use native links for actionable values, and use address only for relevant contact information rather than arbitrary metadata.

behavior.name: responseLifecycle
attributes: role="status" for confirmed non-blocking asynchronous feedback
role="alert" or linked error-summary semantics for dynamically presented blocking errors
behavior.description: Form-level response is truthful, target-owned, and never repurposed as the description of only one field.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, empty, localized, RTL, and unbroken content remains contained through logical component-width-aware composition without viewport- or Studio-owned layout rules.

behavior.name: zeroNeutralRuntime
behavior.description: Contact Form itself owns no field store, listener, observer, request, timer, layout read, custom element, asset, animation, or neutral runtime.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Render no title and use a generic root instead of an unnamed native section.
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose the contextual heading rank and unique id.

properties.name: description
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the description without leaving an empty node or rhythm.
properties.description: Optional supporting contact copy that never replaces the visible title as a section name.

properties.name: formLabel
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Contact Form when the localized accessible form label is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty localized accessible name for the native form landmark; it does not replace visible field labels.

properties.name: details
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the contact-information list; also omit the information region if no title or description remains.
properties.description: Optional target-owned ordered contact-detail composition using native links and appropriate contact semantics.

properties.name: form
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the complete Contact Form when no valid native form composition is supplied.
properties.description: Required target-owned native form composition built from canonical Input, Textarea, and Button.

accessibility: Render a native title-labelled section only when a visible title exists; otherwise use a generic div.
Give the native form a required non-empty localized accessible name and keep visual/source/tab order aligned.
Associate every native field with a visible label and give every submitted control a stable name.
Use native input types, required, autocomplete, length, readonly, disabled, and constraint-validation semantics instead of recreating them with ARIA or script.
Communicate required status visibly and use aria-describedby only for messages that actually describe the referenced field.
Use aria-invalid=true only for Error; Success and Warning remain distinguishable without claiming invalid state.
Use native mailto and tel links for actionable contact details and preserve visible focus.
Use one explicit canonical submit Button and preserve its disabled, busy, accessible-name, and focus behavior.
Announce only confirmed submission outcomes; a preview that performs no request must say that no message was sent.
For multiple target validation errors, prefer a concise linked summary before the fields and preserve entered non-sensitive values.

web.notes: Conditional section semantics and intrinsic S10 CSS compose one named native form from canonical Input, Textarea, and Button; targets own the submission lifecycle.

shopify.notes: Localized merchant section uses Shopify's contact form tag, platform field names, server errors, confirmed success, canonical classes, and zero S10 JavaScript.
